assumptions.statement: The current core supplies a constrained coherence structural functional on no-current, frozen-current, or uniquely smoothly slaved reduced branches; it does not supply a general joint structural functional for independently active current.

D1 admits A and B as independent runtime causal coordinates and C as a derived constitutive sector, but runtime causal authority does not automatically make a coordinate part of the structural continuation domain.

D3 defines local structural requirements on smooth fixed-topology strata and blocks classical derivatives across rank, mode-crossing, branch, or topology-event boundaries until explicit interspace transport exists.
D3 classifies reference-current regimes without selecting one; D6 owns current closure and D8 may consume only the corresponding admitted D3 row.
This gate freezes structural-domain requirements and source support. It does not construct a formed branch, calculate a Hessian, execute a transition, or report spectra.
